info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems

item.name: Factset Get Afi Optimization Status by Id

variable.description: (Required) from url, provided from the location header in the Create and Run AFI optimization endpoint

request.description:
This is the endpoint to check on the progress of a previously requested optimization.
If the optimization has finished computing, the body of the response will contain result in JSON.
Otherwise, the optimization is still running and the X-FactSet-Api-PickUp-Progress header will contain a progress percentage.

response.name: Expected response once optimization is completed, returns JSON.
